title: Thread Trigger
text: Call downstream function-call subsystem when selected input edge transition occurs, 1 input, 1 output, {Trigger Edge} sets Selects trigger edge type Rising; {ISR Task Priority} sets the selects the ISR task priority for function. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: T
ports.summary: Trigger input tested for selected transition boolean

ports.name: F
ports.summary: Function call output for task function call

params.name: Trigger Edge
params.values: Selects trigger edge type Rising Edge (default) | Falling Edge | Both Edges

params.name: ISR Task Priority
params.values: Selects the ISR task priority for function 245 (high priority) (default) | 235 (medium priority) | 225 (low priority)
